subject.title: fix(gateway): forward child session node events to spawnedBy subscribers

question: Should gateway node subscribers to a parent session implicitly receive spawned child-session events, or should the fix require explicit child subscription/notification instead?
rationale: Both designs can solve the missed child-event bug, but implicit ancestor fanout changes the delivery contract for existing parent subscribers and needs gateway owner intent.

options.title: Accept ancestor fanout
options.body: Repair the cache defect and land parent-to-child delivery as the gateway node subscription contract.

options.title: Require explicit child subscription
options.body: Replace this with spawn-time subscription propagation or a child-spawn notification so clients opt into each child key.

recommendation.title: Accept ancestor fanout
recommendation.body: Repair the cache defect and land parent-to-child delivery as the gateway node subscription contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is a maintainer draft by vincentkoc and the requested delivery contract is gateway-owner behavior in the branch.
